recurrent_text_conditioning: separate GRU-128 consumes previous native event, full text mean, style and log token count; predicts three monotonic Gaussian windows; learned window feeds complete trajectory GRU
geometry_density_gain: curve displacement and curvature errors multiplied by source-height gain and native events per supplied text token, bounded 1..64; pen-lift locations use source-height units without density gain
duration_parameterization: log text-token count plus learned log events-per-token residual; initialize residual to log(12)
feedback: canonical MOVE unused controls zero; EOS geometry zero; pen width abs-clamped to 1e-5..1 identically in training and inference
geometry_supervision: equal objective mass per present MOVE and CURVE class; each pen lift is equally weighted, independently of following curve density; MOVE smooth L1 beta .02 source heights; CURVE beta .1 density-scaled source heights
event_supervision: half original stroke weights, half equal mass per observed MOVE/CURVE/EOS class
style_training: zero latent for first 10,000 updates to establish content; then quarter zero, quarter normal prior, half posterior
normalization: reversible em units: scale=max(source height, source width/supplied token count, pen width, 1e-6); original controls and pen lifts unchanged
supervision: every complete train sample, original cubic controls and pen lifts; no inferred character segmentation
events: relative cubic controls, move, curve, EOS, normalized width
decoder: GRU-128 with local and global text context, explicit log token count, masked text cross-attention
sampling: length buckets; deterministic complete source-grouped train epochs
augmentation: none: preserve observed baseline drift, slant, spacing and cubic controls
tokenizer: semantic AST tokens including learned matrix and stretch delimiters
scheduled_sampling: 10,000 updates of canonical zero-style teacher forcing, then alternate teacher/scheduled batches; generated-feedback probability ramps 0..1 over 20,000 further updates; learned-duration feedback only after full ramp
progress: learned Gaussian center divided by text token count; legacy exports retain fixed clock
event_weighting: half uniform, half equal mass per native pen stroke and EOS; preserve short crossbars/dots without character segmentation
rendering: joint complete expression; one isotropic placement; decoder generates all punctuation, brackets, radicals, rules, accents and enclosures
sampling_geometry: most probable Gaussian component mean; diversity only from shared document and run style latent; no independent coordinate noise
joining: learn context-dependent continuation versus pen lift from complete original trajectories; the same character pair may join or separate; never add connector strokes or force a pen lift at character boundaries
public_pretraining: separate optional stage described in public-vector-pretraining-v1.json; never silently mix with personal corpus
attention_units: learned nonnegative increments in token space, cumulative centers; no fixed linear event/text alignment
absolute_geometry_units: source-height units: multiply normalized full-trajectory error by original isotropic scale / source height, bounded 1..32; independent of sentence width
absolute_geometry_reduction: masked smooth L1, beta 0.1 source-height units; retain whole-row point order and pen lifts
alignment_supervision: no inferred character boundaries; complete-row geometry plus end-of-row window coverage
